title: Agenta
tagline: Understand your users with Agenta’s intelligent insights. Just enter a smart contract address, select the agents you need, and boom—you’ll get instant, actionable insights about your users.
description: Agenta is a collection of intelligent agents that help smart contract owners gain deep insights into wallets by analyzing their on-chain interactions. It provides details such as wallet age, interaction patterns, user groups, and user interests, compiling this data into an insightful dashboard for better understanding and decision-making.
how_its_made: We built Agenta with a vision to simplify on-chain analytics for smart contract owners. Using a modular architecture, we designed a collection of intelligent agents, each specialized in analyzing specific wallet behaviors—like interaction patterns, wallet age, and user clustering. Our backend leverages blockchain data pipelines for real-time processing, while machine learning models categorize user interests and predict behavioral patterns. The frontend was crafted to present this complex data through a clean, interactive dashboard, turning raw on-chain data into actionable insights for smarter decisions.
